keyword: how to choose a small concrete pump

title.en: How to Choose a Small Concrete Pump from the Compact Xingtai Rows
title.zh: 如何从邢台紧凑行里选小型混凝土泵

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai shortlists B500S-83D, Electric 15, Electric 10 Series, Tractor-Driven 4100 and the rural diesel pump for a compact order. Compare weight and the printed distance, then inquire.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把 B500S-83D、电动15、电动10系列、拖拉机带动4100和农村柴油泵列为紧凑采购短名单。对照重量和已印距离后再询盘。

h1.en: Choose a Small Pump from the Compact Catalogue Rows
h1.zh: 从紧凑目录行里选小型泵

directAnswer.en: A small-pump order at Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai starts with five compact rows, not with Diesel 120. B500S-83D prints 280 kg and 5 m / 5 m. Electric 15 prints 450 kg. Electric 10 Series prints 400 kg and 25 m horizontal only. Tractor-Driven 4100 prints 1300 kg. The rural diesel pump prints 800 kg. Pick the row whose weight, power and distance you can send unchanged to the contact page.
directAnswer.zh: 在河北品锦机械（邢台）下小型泵订单，从五条紧凑行开始，而不是从柴油120开始。B500S-83D 印 280 kg 和 5 m / 5 m。电动15印 450 kg。电动10系列印 400 kg，并且只有水平 25 m。拖拉机带动4100印 1300 kg。农村柴油泵印 800 kg。选定重量、动力和距离后，按原样发到询盘页。

heading.en: What does the selection note actually name?
heading.zh: 选型说明实际点了哪些？

body.en: The published small-site note says to shortlist B500S-83D first for 5 m sand and small stone, then Electric 15, Electric 10 Series, Tractor-Driven 4100 or the rural diesel pump. Those are five different sheets. [/en/products/b500s-83d-two-stage-pump/](/en/products/b500s-83d-two-stage-pump/) is the 7.5 kW, 380 V, 280 kg page.
body.zh: 已公布的小型工地说明写明：5 m 砂石优先看 B500S-83D，再看电动15、电动10系列、拖拉机带动4100或农村柴油泵。这是五张不同的表。[/zh/products/b500s-83d-two-stage-pump/](/zh/products/b500s-83d-two-stage-pump/) 是 7.5 kW、380 V、280 kg 那一页。

heading.en: Which compact cell is easy to miss?
heading.zh: 紧凑行里哪一格容易漏？

body.en: Electric 10 Series prints horizontal distance only: 25 m. It does not print a vertical line. Electric 15 prints vertical 15–20 m and horizontal 60–80 m, and it does not print hopper volume or outlet pressure. B500S-83D prints 5–16 mm material and a short boom that belongs to the compact unit, not a truck boom.
body.zh: 电动10系列只印水平距离 25 m，没有垂直行。电动15印垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m，不印料斗容积，也不印出口压力。B500S-83D 印 5–16 mm 材料，短臂架属于这台紧凑机，不是车载臂架。

heading.en: What do you send for a compact quote?

body.en: Send the slug, the frame size on that page, maximum stone, the metres you measured, and whether the drive is the printed electric motor, a tractor, or the 17 kW rural diesel. Price stays on [/en/contact/](/en/contact/). Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai does not print a small-pump price list.
body.zh: 发送型号地址、该页外形、最大石子、你量到的米数，以及动力是页上的电机、拖拉机，还是 17 kW 农村柴油。价格留在 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。河北品锦机械（邢台）不印小型泵价目表。

answer.en: No. The sheet says the short boom is part of the compact unit. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list a truck-mounted placing boom.
answer.zh: 不是。该页写明短臂架属于紧凑机。河北品锦机械不列车载布料杆。

question.en: Which compact row has no vertical cell?
question.zh: 哪条紧凑行没有垂直格子？

answer.en: Electric 10 Series. It prints 25 m horizontal, 15 kW, 21 m³/h, hopper 0.1 m³ and 400 kg.
answer.zh: 电动10系列。它印水平 25 m、15 kW、21 m³/h、料斗 0.1 m³、400 kg。

question.en: Is the rural diesel the same as Diesel 30?
question.zh: 农村柴油泵等于柴油30吗？

answer.en: No. The rural page prints 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, 800 kg and 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm. Diesel 30 prints 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 2000 kg and 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm.

question.en: Do these pages print a price?

answer.en: No. Confirm the price with Xingtai through the contact page.
answer.zh: 没有。通过询盘页向邢台确认价格。
